title: Shadow of Backrooms Game Brings Survival Horror to Steam in 2027
text:
Shadow of Backrooms is a first-person survival horror game from solo developer Panuzi, set for Early Access on Steam in 2027 with single-player and four-player co-op.
Shadow of Backrooms, a new first-person horror game based on the Backrooms phenomenon, is set to launch on Steam in 2027. Developed and published by solo developer Panuzi, the title will enter Early Access soon, offering survival, exploration, and puzzle-solving in a liminal world of abandoned rooms and endless corridors. The game supports single-player and online co-op for up to four players, with a full release targeted for the end of 2027.
From Internet Folklore to Horror Franchise
The Backrooms began as an anonymous 2019 post showing an eerie, yellow-tinted space disconnected from reality. Filmmaker Kane Parsons expanded the concept with a viral found-footage series on YouTube, then brought it to theaters with A24's Backrooms. That film became a major box office success, proving the internet-born idea had broad appeal. Parsons is reportedly returning to direct Backrooms 2, and the franchise continues to grow with spinoff projects such as Shadow of Backrooms.
Gameplay and Multiplayer Features
Shadow of Backrooms sends players through abandoned rooms, endless corridors, and surreal environments designed to capture the liminal horror that made the Backrooms concept effective. The objective is simple: explore, find a way forward, and avoid lurking threats. Players will solve puzzles and uncover secrets while trying to escape hostile entities scattered throughout the Backrooms.
The game will support both single-player and online co-op through Steam lobbies. Multiplayer allows groups of up to four people to explore together, making the experience appealing to fans of atmospheric horror. Instead of watching someone else become trapped in impossible spaces, players will navigate them personally, deciding where to go while dealing with puzzles and entities.
Early Access and Development Plans
Panuzi plans to release Shadow of Backrooms in Early Access soon, which means the initial version will not be the finished product. According to the Steam page, the developer intends to use Early Access to regularly add content and mechanics while incorporating player feedback, a common practice for solo and indie studios.
The initial version is expected to contain several explorable levels, puzzles, and entity encounters. However, level design, enemy AI, performance, and other elements will continue to be refined. Planned updates include new liminal environments, improved puzzles, additional narrative material, and further optimization. Panuzi also plans to develop the game's story through updates, potentially giving its version of the Backrooms a more substantial narrative.
The current goal is to reach a full release by the end of 2027, although Panuzi stresses that the schedule remains uncertain. Development could take longer if plans for a more developed story expand the project's scope. The game is also expected to be free initially, with its price potentially increasing gradually as additional content and story elements are introduced. No specific 2027 Early Access date has been announced, but Shadow of Backrooms is available to wishlist on Steam.
